components.css: .ds-row{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC",sans-serif;line-height:1.65;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 130px 130px;gap:24px;align-items:center;padding:24px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dce3dd);color:var(--ink,#25322e)}.ds-row:hover{background:#edf2eb}.ds-row h2{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 7px}.ds-row p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#57655f);max-width:70ch;margin:0}.ds-row a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:40px;font-size:12px;color:var(--accent,#236249);text-decoration:none}.ds-row a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-tag{display:inline-block;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:5px;font-size:12px;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC",sans-serif;line-height:1.65;background:var(--tag-bg,#e5ebe4);color:var(--tag-ink,#48594d);white-space:nowrap}.ds-tag-integrated{background:var(--integrated-bg,#e2eee5);color:var(--integrated-ink,#225238)}.ds-tag-pending{background:var(--pending-bg,#f1e7d4);color:var(--pending-ink,#714f1e)}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-text:focus-visible,.ds-search input:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible,.ds-tabs button:focus-visible,.ds-row a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#b37b2a);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:12px;padding:20px 0}.ds-row>div{grid-column:1/-1}.ds-row a{justify-self:end}}

narrative.overview:
Dark forest navigation frames a cool, light reading workspace. The visual language is quiet and practical: a serif headline introduces each view, while compact sans-serif controls and metadata support sustained reading.

Depth comes from distinct surface tones and fine dividers. Tool entries use aligned directory rows; large white containers hold reading content or a detailed explanation. Public report pages retain their own visual systems inside the embedded reader.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navigation beside light reading surfaces.
Editorial serif headings with compact sans-serif controls.
Forest-green actions and restrained brass accents.
Flat surfaces, fine dividers, and modest rounded corners.

rules.name: The Surface Contrast Rule
rules.body: Preserve the dark navigation and light reading relationship.

dos: Do retain dark navigation beside light reading surfaces.
Do use serif type for view headlines and sans-serif type for controls and prose.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do distinguish connected reports, external entries, and pending capabilities through clear text and status treatment.
donts: Don't add shadows or hover lift to the flat reading containers.
Don't turn every tool directory row into a promotional card.
Don't replace readable status text with color alone.
